items.source_en:
Lady luck threw me a bone, because I've been discharged. They must've gotten my medical records switched with another agent, because reading the files, it's based on a disease I don't have. Shame for the other guy, but I'm not gonna bother correcting them.

Oh, and here's a laugh. Now that I'm coming home for sure, Mujeen's changed his tune. He keeps telling me how he's proud of my service and how he has all these plans to adopt me into House Ka'dic.

What he really means is, I may be free of my contract, but I'm still working for him. We'll see about that.

아, 그리고 웃긴 일이 생겼다. 이제 내가 고향에 돌아오는 게 확실해지자 무진도 말투가 바뀌었다. 계속 내가 의무를 다한 것에 자랑스럽다고 말하며 날 카딕 가문의 피후견자로 받아 주겠다 했고 계획도 다 준비해 놨다고 했다.

As I write this, there are three of us left: Sirak, Basira, and myself. We have all accepted the inevitable, that either we're destined to fall victim to these "Vortex Phantoms," as Sirak calls them, or we're destined to become them. I pray it's the latter.
